definitions.explanation: To make fabric by interlacing threads on a loom.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{着物|きもの}の{布|ぬの}を{織|お}っていた。
examples.english: My grandmother used to weave kimono fabric.

examples.japanese: {手|て}{織|お}りの{絨毯|じゅうたん}は{高価|こうか}だ。
{絹|きぬ}を{織|お}る{技術|ぎじゅつ}を{学|まな}ぶ。
examples.english: I'm learning the technique of weaving silk.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Intransitive pair: {織|お}れる (can be woven - potential). Pattern: Xを{織|お}る (to weave X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {織|お}っている = 'is weaving.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {布|ぬの}を{織|お}る (to weave cloth)
- {糸|いと}を{織|お}る (to weave thread)
- {機|はた}で{織|お}る (to weave on a loom)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {手|て}{織|お}り (hand-woven)
- {機|はた}{織|お}り (weaving, loom work)
- {織物|おりもの} (woven fabric, textile)

CULTURAL NOTE: Weaving has a long tradition in Japan, particularly for kimono fabrics like {西陣織|にしじんおり} (Nishijin weaving).
